name: GitHub Script
description: Run simple scripts using the GitHub client

github-token.description: The GitHub token used to create an authenticated client

debug.description: Whether to tell the GitHub client to log details of its requests. true or false. Default is to run in debug mode when the GitHub Actions step debug logging is t

previews.description: A comma-separated list of GraphQL API previews to accept

result-encoding.description: Either "string" or "json" (default "json")—how the result will be encoded

retries.description: The number of times to retry a request

retry-exempt-status-codes.description: A comma separated list of status codes that will NOT be retried e.g. "400,500". No effect unless `retries` is set

base-url.description: An optional GitHub REST API URL to connect to a different GitHub instance. For example, https://my.github-enterprise-server.com/api/v3
